name: coursekit
summary: Installable and portable agent skill package that turns a learning goal into a runnable course: dependency-ordered syllabus, compiled interactive board, lessons, gradable homework, mastery-gated progression, spaced review, and a periodic frontier pass.

installation.portable: Feed study-coach/SKILL.md into the host context and load study-coach/references/*.md on demand; run scripts with any python3 that can import yaml

notes.package_vs_skill_name: The package is coursekit; the installed skill is study-coach. The skill directory keeps the short call name so invocation stays cheap.
notes.build_artifacts: 课程主页.html and 课程进度.md are compiled by sync.py and must never be hand-edited.
notes.scheduling: No automations are shipped. schedule.py emits a rebuildable recipe because automations are host state.
